review.imagery: Seventeen own-project renders were visually reviewed. Fifteen distinct native brochure scenes and two current-gallery views cover the complete tower, aerial, leisure spaces, cinema, lobby, home interiors and gym. The identical page-24 panorama, generic people photographs and repeated gallery crops are excluded. The complete daytime tower supplies the card and hero. Views and fitout remain proposed and unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Three home drawings are from the official brochure. Two complete building sheets are from a REM-hosted broker-platform mirror of the branded plan pack. Its three repeated home sheets remain in the original PDF. The two-bedroom drawing includes a store. Numerical unit areas and home-to-unit matching are not supplied. Confirm the approved layout and contractual area with SAMANA. All three official home sheets on pages 33–35 and all five mirror drawing pages 2–3 and 5–7 were visually reviewed. The mirror’s three home drawings duplicate the official drawings and are not counted as additional choices. Both first-floor gyms, full podium and floors-2–20 footprint remain visible. Numerical areas are not inferred from category minima.
review.location: Complete official regional map page 8 and travel panel page 9 were visually reviewed. All ten travel entries agree with the current page. The name-only map query is recorded with source hash. No coordinates, road distances, live routes or operational transport claims are invented.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, original official brochure and current-gallery receipts retain hashes. Brochure page 28 names Barari Lagoons and is excluded from project claims. The supplementary floorplate pack is honestly labeled as a REM-hosted broker-platform mirror. Original bytes, unedited sheets and physical PDF links remain available. Protected identity and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, approved home-to-unit mapping, final fitout, verified entrance coordinates and dated construction photographs were not established.
